p.src: 1  Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—

en: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—
u.src: 1  Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—

p.src: 2  as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

en: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
u.src: 2  as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

p.src: 3  When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.

en: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
u.src: 3  When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.

p.src: 4  For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

en: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.
u.src: 4  For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

p.src: 5  You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

en: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?
u.src: 5  You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

p.src: 6  For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

en: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
u.src: 6  For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

p.src: 7  There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

en: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.
u.src: 7  There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

p.src: 8  But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

en: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
u.src: 8  But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

p.src: 9  Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

en: Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.
u.src: 9  Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

p.src: 10  Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

en: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
u.src: 10  Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

p.src: 11  Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

en: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.
u.src: 11  Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

p.src: 12  Will you hold yourself back for these things, LORD? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?

en: Will you hold yourself back for these things, LORD? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?
u.src: 12  Will you hold yourself back for these things, LORD? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?
